#Adjusted code
```{r}
# pheno_raw.rds (patient-level raw clinical records) is NOT included in this
# repository. The final normalized matrix is provided at
# ../data/clinical_phenotype_analysis/nor_pheno_by_Age_Gender_CCI.rds and
# ../data/clinical_phenotype_analysis/MIL/prepeare/nor_pheno_by_Age_Gender_CCI.csv.
pheno_raw2<-readRDS("../data/clinical_phenotype_analysis/pheno_raw.rds")
metainfo_chengdu<-read.xlsx("../data/Chengdu_data/Chengdu_metainfo.xlsx")
pheno_raw2<-pheno_raw2[pheno_raw2$Name%in%metainfo_chengdu$sample_id,]
setDT(pheno_raw2)
pheno2 <- pheno_raw2
pheno3 <- pheno2

NormFun <- function(x) {
  bestNormalize::orderNorm(x)$x.t
}

pt <- 6:83

for (j in pt) {
  # print(j)
  Tab0 <- pheno2[, c(2, 3, 4, j), with = FALSE]
  colnames(Tab0)[4] <- "before"
  
  # 1. INT
  Tab0[!is.na(before), Normal1 := NormFun(before)]
  # 2. Outlier Removal (+- 3SD)
  Tab0[!is.na(Normal1), Type := ifelse(Normal1 < mean(Normal1) - 3 * sd(Normal1) | 
                                       Normal1 > mean(Normal1) + 3 * sd(Normal1), "O", "I")]
  # 3. INT again
  Tab0[Type == "I", Normal2 := NormFun(before)]
  Tab0[Type == "O", Normal2 := NA]
  
  # 4. Regression
  set.seed(123)
  train.control <- caret::trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)
  Tab0[, beta0 := 1]
  
  current_var <- var(Tab0$Normal2[!is.na(Tab0$Normal2)])
  if (is.na(current_var) || current_var == 0) {
    print(paste("Trait:", j, "Skipping: Zero variance"))
    pheno3[[j]] <- NA
    next
  }
  
  step.model <- caret::train(Normal2 ~ beta0 + Age + Gender + CCI_Score_Quan2011, 
                      data = Tab0[!is.na(Normal2), ],
                      method = "leapSeq",
                      tuneGrid = data.frame(nvmax = 1:3),
                      trControl = train.control)
  
  # 5. Residuals & 6. INT
  Tab0[!is.na(Normal2), residuals := residuals(step.model)]
  Tab0[!is.na(Normal2), after := NormFun(residuals)]
  pheno3[[j]] <- Tab0$after
  
  rm(list = c("Tab0", "step.model"))
  gc()
}
saveRDS(pheno3, "../data/clinical_phenotype_analysis/nor_pheno_by_Age_Gender_CCI.rds")
```

```{r}
pheno1 <- as.data.table(readRDS("../data/clinical_phenotype_analysis/nor_pheno_by_Age_Gender_CCI.rds"))

  dplyr::group_by(Confirmed_date) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(daily_cases = n()) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Confirmed_date) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cumulative_cases = cumsum(daily_cases))

            linetype = "dashed",

    name = "Daily number of cases", 
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * scale_factor, name = "Cumulative number of cases")
```

#Pearson correlation analys over time
```{r}
pheno1 <- readRDS('../data/clinical_phenotype_analysis/nor_pheno_by_Age_Gender_CCI.rds')
ins_pheno_map <- read.xlsx("../data/clinical_phenotype_analysis/clinical_phenotype_ref.xlsx")
ins_pheno_map$Severity.relationship[grepl('Unknow', ins_pheno_map$Severity.relationship)] <- "Unknown"
ins_pheno_map$Severity.relationship[grepl('Positive', ins_pheno_map$Severity.relationship)] <- "Severe"
ins_pheno_map$Severity.relationship[grepl('Negative', ins_pheno_map$Severity.relationship)] <- "Nonsevere"
ins_pheno_map$Trait <- gsub(" ", ".", ins_pheno_map$Trait)
length(intersect(colnames(pheno1),ins_pheno_map$Trait))#78

# Time Correlation Analysis
pheno1$Confirmed_date <- as.Date(pheno1$Confirmed_date)
pheno1<-pheno1[order(pheno1$Confirmed_date,decreasing = F),]


cor_res <- lapply(6:83, function(i) {
  pheno1 <- as.data.frame(pheno1)
  tmp1<-pheno1[,c(5,i)]
  colnames(tmp1)[2]<-"v1"
  tmp1<-tmp1[!is.na(tmp1$v1),]
  tmp1$od<-1:nrow(tmp1)
  cor_test <- cor.test(tmp1$od, tmp1$v1, method = "pearson")
  data.frame(
    trait = colnames(pheno1)[i],
    correlation_coef = cor_test$estimate,
    pvalue = cor_test$p.value,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>% do.call(rbind, .)

cor_res$Severe_type <- ins_pheno_map$Severity.relationship[match(cor_res$trait, ins_pheno_map$Trait)]
cor_res$Severe_type <- factor(cor_res$Severe_type, levels = c("Severe", "Nonsevere", "Unknown"))


saveRDS(cor_res,"../data/clinical_phenotype_analysis/Time_cef_CCI.rds")

cor_res<-readRDS("../data/clinical_phenotype_analysis/Time_cef_CCI.rds")

#TableS4
cor_res$Ref<-ins_pheno_map$Ref[match(cor_res$trait,ins_pheno_map$Trait)]
write.xlsx(cor_res,"../table/TableS4_clinical_feature_tepmoral_analysis.xlsx")
#Fig2B
p1 <- ggplot(cor_res, aes(x = correlation_coef, y = -log10(pvalue), color = Severe_type, label = trait)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7,aes(size=abs(correlation_coef))) +
   # geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.2,-0.2), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Severe" = "#E41A1C", "Nonsevere" = "#377EB8", "Unknown" = "#999999")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text_repel() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  labs(x = "PCC", y = "-log10 (P-value)",color="",size="Absoluted PCC")

ggsave("../result/03clinical_phenotype_analysis/volcano_timeCoef.pdf", p1, width = 7, height = 4.5)



#FigS2A
cor_res$group<-ifelse(cor_res$correlation_coef>0,"Positive","Negative")
table(cor_res$group[cor_res$pvalue<0.05])
cor_res_sig<-cor_res[cor_res$pvalue<0.05,]
cor_res_sig$freq=1

df_test<-aggregate(data=cor_res_sig,freq~Severe_type+group,sum)
df_test$pct<-NA
df_test$pct[c(1,2,3)]<-(df_test$freq[c(1,2,3)]/22)*100
df_test$pct[c(4,5,6)]<-(df_test$freq[c(4,5,6)]/16)*100
df_test$group<-factor(df_test$group,levels = c("Positive","Negative"))

p4<-ggplot(df_test, aes(x = group, y = freq, fill = Severe_type)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.6, color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
   geom_text(aes(label = freq),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
            vjust = -0.3,
            size = 5)+
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))+
   scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E41A1C","#377EB8","grey"))+
  theme_classic2(base_size = 16)+
  labs(x="",y="Number of trait",fill="")+
  scale_y_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 13),
  breaks = seq(0,12,3)
)
ggsave("../result/03clinical_phenotype_analysis/Trait_severe_barplot_by_cor.pdf", p4, width = 5.3, height = 3.7)


#FigS3
trait_info <- cor_res_sig %>%
  dplyr::select(trait, correlation_coef) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

trait_info$group2 <- cor_res_sig$Severe_type[match(trait_info$trait, cor_res_sig$trait)]

trait_info$title_col <- ifelse(trait_info$group2 == "Severe", "#E41A1C",
                               ifelse(trait_info$group2 == "Nonsevere", "#377EB8", "black"))


trait_pos<-trait_info[trait_info$correlation_coef > 0,]
trait_pos <- trait_pos$trait[order(trait_pos$correlation_coef,decreasing = T)]
trait_neg <- trait_info[trait_info$correlation_coef < 0,]
trait_neg <- trait_neg$trait[order(trait_neg$correlation_coef,decreasing = F)]

plot_list_pos <- lapply(trait_pos, function(tr){

  tmp1 <- pheno1[!is.na(pheno1[[tr]]),]
  tmp1<-tmp1[order(tmp1$Confirmed_date,decreasing = F),]
  tmp1$od <- 1:nrow(tmp1)

  title_col <- trait_info$title_col[match(tr, trait_info$trait)]

  ggplot(tmp1, aes(x = od, y = .data[[tr]])) +
    geom_point(color = "#00BFC4", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#F8766D", se = TRUE) +
    stat_cor(method = "pearson", aes(label = paste0("italic(r)~`=`~", signif(after_stat(r), 2), "~`,`~italic(p)~`=`~", signif(after_stat(p), 2))), parse = TRUE, label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top")  +
    theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(color = title_col,  hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown(color = title_col, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Time",
      y = paste0("<span style='color:", title_col, ";'>", tr, "</span>")
    )
})

plot_list_neg <- lapply(trait_neg, function(tr){

  tmp1 <- pheno1[!is.na(pheno1[[tr]]),]
  tmp1<-tmp1[order(tmp1$Confirmed_date,decreasing = F),]
  tmp1$od <- 1:nrow(tmp1)

  title_col <- trait_info$title_col[match(tr, trait_info$trait)]

  ggplot(tmp1, aes(x = od, y = .data[[tr]])) +
    geom_point(color = "#00BFC4", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#F8766D", se = TRUE) +
    stat_cor(method = "pearson", aes(label = paste0("italic(r)~`=`~", signif(after_stat(r), 2), "~`,`~italic(p)~`=`~", signif(after_stat(p), 2))), parse = TRUE, label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top")  +
    theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(color = title_col, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown(color = title_col, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Time",
      y = paste0("<span style='color:", title_col, ";'>", tr, "</span>")
    )
})

p_pos <- wrap_plots(plot_list_pos, ncol = 5) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Positive Correlation Traits")

p_neg <- wrap_plots(plot_list_neg, ncol = 5) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Negative Correlation Traits")

p_all <- p_pos / p_neg + plot_layout(heights = c(4, 5))
ggsave("../result/03clinical_phenotype_analysis/Triat_timeCoef.pdf", p_all, width = 14, height = 21)


#Fig2C,FigS2B-C
trait_severity <- ins_pheno_map %>%

traits_use <- trait_severity %>%

severity_col <- c(Severe="#E41A1C",Nonsevere="#377EB8",Unknown="grey50")

  dplyr::summarise(relative_order=mean(relative_order,na.rm=TRUE),value=mean(trait_mean,na.rm=TRUE),n_trait=dplyr::n_distinct(Trait),.groups="drop")

table(cor_res$Severe_type)
#Severe Nonsevere   Unknown

p2_order <- ggplot2::ggplot()+
```

##EVEscape fitness
###MSA
```{r}
gene_struc <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("../data/SARS_CoV_2_reference/SARS-CoV-2_gene_structure.new.xlsx")
gene_struc <- as.data.table(gene_struc)
gene_struc <- gene_struc[!is.na(gene)]
gene_struc[!grepl("nsp", gene), gene := ORF]
gene_struc$gene[1:17]<-toupper(gene_struc$gene[1:17])

genome <- readDNAStringSet("../data/SARS_CoV_2_reference/MN908947.genome.fasta")[[1]]

# Set this to your EVEscape installation directory
# (https://github.com/debbiemarkslab/EVEscape)
evescape_dir <- "~/EVEscape"


getRefseq <- function(protein,genome, gene_structure) {
  targene_ranges <- gene_structure[gene_structure$gene==protein]
    exon_seq <- subseq(genome, (targene_ranges$start), (targene_ranges$end))
    protein_seq <- Biostrings::translate(exon_seq)
  return(protein_seq)
}

gene_struc<-gene_struc[-12:-13,]
lapply(gene_struc$gene,function(g){
  seq<-getRefseq(g,genome, gene_struc)
  seq<- AAStringSet(seq)
  names(seq)<-g
  writeXStringSet(seq,paste0(evescape_dir,"/data/Covid_UniRef_seq/",g,"_ref.fasta"))
})

gene_struc_2<-data.table(features=c("gene","gene",gene_struc$features[18:27]),
                           start=c(266,13468,gene_struc$start[18:27]),
                           end=c(13468,21555,gene_struc$end[18:27]),
                           ORF=c("ORF1a","ORF1b",gene_struc$ORF[18:27]),
                           locus_tag=c(NA,NA,gene_struc$locus_tag[18:27]),
                           gene=c("ORF1a","ORF1b",gene_struc$gene[18:27]),
                           protein_id=c(NA,NA,gene_struc$protein_id[18:27]),
                            note=c(NA,NA,gene_struc$note[18:27]))
seq_orf1a<-getRefseq("ORF1a",genome, gene_struc_2)
seq_orf1a<- AAStringSet(seq_orf1a)
names(seq_orf1a)<-"ORF1a"
writeXStringSet(seq_orf1a,paste0(evescape_dir,"/data/Covid_UniRef_seq/","ORF1a","_ref.fasta"))

seq_NSP12_1<- subseq(genome, 13442, 13468)
seq_NSP12_2<- subseq(genome, 13468, 16236)
seq_NSP12_1<- Biostrings::translate(seq_NSP12_1)
seq_NSP12_2<- Biostrings::translate(seq_NSP12_2)
seq_NSP12<- AAStringSet(c(seq_NSP12_1,seq_NSP12_2))
names(seq_NSP12)<-"NSP12"
writeXStringSet(seq_NSP12,paste0(evescape_dir,"/data/Covid_UniRef_seq/","NSP12_ref.fasta"))
```

```{bash}
# Run from the EVcoupling directory of your EVEscape installation where the
# *_config.txt files were written above (adjust the path accordingly).
cd ~/EVEscape/data/EVcoupling
for g in NSP2 NSP3 NSP4 NSP5 NSP6 NSP7 NSP8 NSP9 NSP10 NSP11 NSP12 NSP13 NSP14 NSP15 NSP16 S ORF3a E M ORF6 ORF7a ORF7b ORF8 N ORF10;
do
    echo ${g}
    evcouplings_runcfg ${g}_config.txt
done
```

```{r}
gene_struc <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("../data/SARS_CoV_2_reference/SARS-CoV-2_gene_structure.new.xlsx")
gene_struc <- as.data.table(gene_struc)

gene_struc[!grepl("nsp", gene), gene := ORF]
gene_struc$gene[1:17]<-toupper(gene_struc$gene[1:17])
gene_struc<-gene_struc[-12,]
prot_map<-data.frame(protein_name=paste0(gene_struc$gene,"_EVE"),msa_location=paste0(gene_struc$gene,"_EVE.a2m"),theta=0.01)
write.csv(prot_map,paste0(evescape_dir,"/data/EVcoupling/output/protein_mapping.csv"),sep = ",",col.names = T,row.names = F,quote = F)

prot_length<-lapply(gene_struc$gene,function(g){
  tmp1<-readAAStringSet(paste0(evescape_dir,"/data/Covid_UniRef_seq/",g,"_ref.fasta"))
   tmp2<-data.frame(protein=g,length=width(tmp1))
   return(tmp2)
})%>%do.call(rbind,.)
```

##Viral genotype
```{r}
metainfo_chengdu<-read.xlsx("../data/Chengdu_data/Chengdu_metainfo.xlsx")
pheno1 <- readRDS('../data/clinical_phenotype_analysis/nor_pheno_by_Age_Gender_CCI.rds')
metainfo_chengdu<-metainfo_chengdu[metainfo_chengdu$sample_id%in%pheno1$Name,]#490
nnSub<-lapply(metainfo_chengdu$sample_id,function(i){
nnSubs<-strsplit(metainfo_chengdu$substitutions[metainfo_chengdu$sample_id==i],",")%>%unlist()
  if(length(nnSubs)>0){
    tmp1<-data.frame(sample_id=i,nnSub=nnSubs)

genome <- readDNAStringSet("../data/SARS_CoV_2_reference/MN908947.genome.fasta")[[1]]

Mut2AA <- function(id, genome, gene_structure) {
  ref <- unlist(strsplit(stringr::str_remove_all(id, "([[:digit:]])"), ""))[1]
  alt <- unlist(strsplit(stringr::str_remove_all(id, "([[:digit:]])"), ""))[2]
  pos <- as.numeric(stringr::str_remove_all(id, "([[:alpha:]])"))
  
  stopifnot(as.character(subseq(genome, pos, pos)) == ref)
  genome2 <- Biostrings::replaceLetterAt(x = genome, at = pos, letter = alt)
  stopifnot(as.character(subseq(genome2, pos, pos)) == alt)
  targene <- unique(names(unlist(gene_structure))[start(unlist(gene_structure)) <= pos & end(unlist(gene_structure)) >= pos])
  
  if(length(targene) == 0) {
    return(paste0("intergenic","(",id,")"))
  } else {
    if(length(targene) == 1) {
      gene_structure_i <- gene_structure[[targene]]
      cds1 <- DNAString(paste0(lapply(seq_along(gene_structure_i), function(i) {
        as.character(subseq(genome, start(gene_structure_i[i]), end(gene_structure_i[i])))
      }), collapse = ""))
      cds2 <- DNAString(paste0(lapply(seq_along(gene_structure_i), function(i) {
        as.character(subseq(genome2, start(gene_structure_i[i]), end(gene_structure_i[i])))
      }), collapse = ""))
      
      p1 <- Biostrings::translate(cds1); p2 <- Biostrings::translate(cds2)
      
      pos2 <- which(unlist(strsplit(as.character(p1), "")) != unlist(strsplit(as.character(p2), "")))
      if(length(pos2) == 0) {
        pos2=ceiling((pos-gene_structure_i@start)/3)
        pos2<-pos2[1]
        ref2 <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(p1), ""))[pos2]
        alt2 <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(p2), ""))[pos2]
         paste0(mapply(seq_along(pos2), FUN = function(j) {
          return(paste0("Synonymous:",toupper(targene), ":", ref2[j], pos2[j], alt2[j]))
        }), collapse = "; ")
      } else {
        ref2 <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(p1), ""))[pos2]
        alt2 <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(p2), ""))[pos2]
        paste0(mapply(seq_along(pos2), FUN = function(j) {
          return(paste0(toupper(targene), ":", ref2[j], pos2[j], alt2[j]))
        }), collapse = "; ")
      }
    } else {
      res <- lapply(targene, function(g) {
        gene_structure_i <- gene_structure[[g]]
        cds1 <- DNAString(paste0(lapply(seq_along(gene_structure_i), function(i) {
          as.character(subseq(genome, start(gene_structure_i[i]), end(gene_structure_i[i])))
        }), collapse = ""))
        cds2 <- DNAString(paste0(lapply(seq_along(gene_structure_i), function(i) {
          as.character(subseq(genome2, start(gene_structure_i[i]), end(gene_structure_i[i])))
        }), collapse = ""))
        
        p1 <- Biostrings::translate(cds1); p2 <- Biostrings::translate(cds2)
        
        pos2 <- which(unlist(strsplit(as.character(p1), "")) != unlist(strsplit(as.character(p2), "")))
        if(length(pos2) == 0) {
        pos2=ceiling((pos-gene_structure_i@start)/3)
        pos2<-pos2[1]
        ref2 <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(p1), ""))[pos2]
        alt2 <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(p2), ""))[pos2]
         paste0(mapply(seq_along(pos2), FUN = function(j) {
          return(paste0("Synonymous:",toupper(g), ":", ref2[j], pos2[j], alt2[j]))
        }), collapse = "; ")
        } else {
          ref2 <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(p1), ""))[pos2]
          alt2 <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(p2), ""))[pos2]
          paste0(mapply(seq_along(pos2), FUN = function(j) {
            return(paste0(toupper(g), ":", ref2[j], pos2[j], alt2[j]))
          }), collapse = "; ")
        }
      })
      return(paste0(do.call(c, res), collapse = "; "))
    }
  }
}



mut_map<-lapply(unique(nnSub$nnSub),function(id){
```

```{r}
 make_protein_order_plot <- function(plot_df,sort_protein){
  trait_order_tmp <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(as.character(protein) == sort_protein) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(freq)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(trait)

  plot_df_tmp <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels = trait_order_tmp), protein = factor(as.character(protein), levels = stack_levels))

  p_tmp <- ggplot(plot_df_tmp, aes(x = trait, y = freq, fill = protein)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.8, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = protein_color[stack_levels], breaks = stack_levels, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = axis_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of top mutations", fill = "Protein", title = paste0("Ordered by ", sort_protein, " proportion")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 60, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), legend.position = "right")

  return(p_tmp)
}
```
